exposure: Robson group 1 (nulliparous women with singleton pregnancy at term in spontaneous labour)
Robson group 5 (multiparous women with at least one previous CS)
Robson group 3 (multiparous women without previous CS, with singleton pregnancy in spontaneous labour)
cohort: 4004 women who gave birth in Hawassa University Referral Hospital from June 2018 to June 2019
finding: A high proportion of women giving birth at Hawassa University Referral Hospital received a caesarean section, with many in low-risk groups, and few having a trial of labour.
